releaseNotes: 6.4.2 (beta): Z-Wave: Failed messages replaces PER; on Z/IP it shows the failure rate and flags a node above 1%; on Z-Wave JS it is not shown and nodes are judged on state; mesh totals replace Avg PER. Network tab no longer waits for the hub's runtime stats; Performance tab opens at once and fills in runtime stats when they arrive.
